description: A campaign's sessions in order of their position, for the campaign page: each with its id, its order (the session number), its title, its date, its status (prep, live or closed) with the label SessionLifecycle@1 gives it, the ids of the PCs present and its summary — shown for a closed session, null while none is written. A session's scenes, journal and detail are other reads.
output: { id: string, order: number, title: string, date: string | null, status: 'prep' | 'live' | 'closed', label: string | null, present: string[], summary: string | null }[]
